test_single_image_chat_completion: test the ImageOpenAITestMixin method that sends a single image and describes it via OpenAI-compatible API
test_multi_images_chat_completion: test the ImageOpenAITestMixin method that sends two images and describes them in one request
test_multi_turn_chat_completion: test the ImageOpenAITestMixin method that performs multi-turn chat with an image and follow-up text
test_mixed_batch: test the ImageOpenAITestMixin method that runs concurrent image decode requests using a thread pool
test_video_images_chat_completion: test the ImageOpenAITestMixin method that extracts frames from a video and sends them as image messages
test_video_chat_completion: test the VideoOpenAITestMixin method that sends a video file and describes its content
test_audio_speech_completion: test the AudioOpenAITestMixin method that transcribes human speech from an audio file
test_audio_ambient_completion: test the AudioOpenAITestMixin method that transcribes ambient sounds like bird songs
test_mixed_modality_chat_completion: test the OmniOpenAITestMixin method that sends both an image and audio in a single request
build_test_server: build a test server using TestOpenAIMLLMServerBase setUpClass to launch SGL with multimodal support
